items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: so it was between Sidney Pritikon and I -- and, for two weeks, we were featured

ctx.x: And, he needed somebody to front the other band--

To front the other band - so it was between Sidney Pritikon and I -- and, for two weeks, we were featured -- first he on the guitar and me singing and playing the cornet and, then, they had the contest with votes -- the audience writing in and, uh, I won the damn thing hands down. I was way ahead and it meant that I would have been the leader which was very disappointing to me; I would have been the leader of the Charlie Kaley Band -- so, it would have been Wild Bill Davison's Band - no -- Bill Davison's Band at…
And, you would have made a lot of money too---
